issues.issue: Confirmed visually as the report's own rounding, not a misread. Every Total-column line adds to 705,147. The nonmajor Miscellaneous total 379 (p9) is 1 more than its columns (252 + 126 = 378), and the nonmajor and Total 'revenues over expenditures' (-47,906 and 2,449,950) were computed with the 1-lower figure. The difference is correctly recorded. FY2023 ending fund balance 3,681,708 equals Callaway_FY2024 beginning_fund_balance 3,681,708.

issues.on_page: Personnel services 120,323 (General 9,968; Street 25,517; Hall 7,056; Pool 24,715; LB840 10,038; Nonmajor 43,029)
issues.issue: This Total-column object line covers every fund, but all of it is categorized general government even though only 9,968 is in the General Fund. Supplies 18,367 (disbursements[2]) has the same problem. The report does print functions: the budget statement (p10) lists general government 132,224, streets 109,278, public health 28,900, culture and recreation 417,477 and community development 17,267, and the Statement of Activities (p2) prints expenses by fund. The categories understate streets, culture/recreation and economic development.
This net Total line mixes the General Fund (737) and the Street Fund (-3,546), but its label names only streets/highways, and it has no `computed` naming how the function was chosen.

issues.extracted: Sewer 77,250 / Water 39,462 (receipts[20]-[21] and disbursements[9]-[10] from p2)
issues.on_page: p2 and p10: Sewer 77,250/64,668, Water 39,462/39,119; p8 proprietary statement: Water 77,250/64,668, Sewer 39,462/39,119
issues.issue: The report labels the Water and Sewer amounts inconsistently between statements. The statement lines follow p2 and the detail follows p8, so the same 77,250 is 'Sewer' in receipts but water charges in detail. This is the report's own inconsistency. It is mentioned in notes but not in report_discrepancies, and a person may need to decide which fund is which.

issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 36,073, printed under 'Operating revenues: Charges for services' on p8; a general revenue on p3
issues.issue: The proprietary statement prints this under the Charges for services heading, but the Statement of Activities leaves it out of Charges for services (1,058,712). The 2026-11-06 ruling depends on which statement 'counts' it, so this is a judgment call. Detail lines [86], [96], [104] and [111] have the same question.

Business-type 'Operating expenses' lines are category utilities, while the governmental 'Operating expenses' line uses category Operating (2026-10-29 rule). The same label is categorized two ways in one report. The same applies to the Water, Sewer and Sanitation Operating expenses lines.

issues.on_page: Grant proceeds 5,000 (Park fund; general revenue on p3, not Operating Grants)
issues.issue: The grantor is not stated, so this could be a federal grant or a private donation. It is already flagged for review.
